id: title:MattPua:hide relaxed and wide tile density options

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a utility function and constant for tile spacing choices while retaining existing compatibility, potentially supporting future UI or configuration changes.
review.reason: Adds a new exported function `getTileSpacingChoices` and constant `OFFERED_TILE_SPACINGS` while retaining the full `DASHBOARD_TILE_SPACING_LABELS` record. This could support future changes to restrict available tile spacing options while preserving compatibility with existing dashboards, but the chunk does not show the removal of the 'relaxed' and 'wide' options or the updated UI,
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit is not demonstrated; the chunk does not include the implementation of the removal of options or the updated UI, so the tier is assigned conservatively based on the addition of compatibility-supporting infrastructure.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of getTileSpacingChoices or the removal of the 'relaxed' and 'wide' options from the available choices, nor does it show the removal of the corresponding UI options.
